sentences.en: When you have a pet, they become like a member of the family.
sentences.zh: 当你养了宠物，它们就像是家庭成员一样。

sentences.en: I think it's kind of like, listen, I'm not going to go over to anyone's house and start licking their animals.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这就好比，听着，我可不会去别人家里开始舔他们的动物。

sentences.en: And I don't love when someone else's dog licks my face.
sentences.zh: 而且我也不太喜欢别人的狗舔我的脸。

sentences.en: But I don't care when my own dog does it.
sentences.zh: 但我自己的狗这么做时，我倒不在乎。

sentences.zh: 但我可不想让别人的小孩拉在我身上。

sentences.en: I don't know what that is.

sentences.zh: 这就好像当它是你的家人时，你就不会介意。

sentences.en: Well, I want you to know, when I look this up online, there's a big debate about when and where and how to bond by licking your cat.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我想让你们知道，我在网上查这个的时候，发现关于何时、何地以及如何通过舔猫来建立感情，网上有一场激烈的争论。

sentences.zh: 而且，伙计们，显然还有一个专门卖人类可以购买的假舌头的产业。

sentences.zh: 然后你就可以用那个在它们两眼之间擦一擦。

sentences.zh: 这也是你可以买到的东西。

sentences.zh: 你舔过它们中的任何一只吗？

sentences.zh: 我最后还是换成了手指刷。

sentences.en: And then you can lick your cat.

sentences.zh: 它还——它还——他们有一个像——像——像——一个肌肉发达的

sentences.zh: 好吧，现在我不知道该期待什么了。

sentences.en: Michael McCartney has been on Law & Order.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·麦卡特尼演过《法律与秩序》。
还有《法律与秩序：犯罪倾向》。

sentences.en: Future guest star, if you could be on all three Law & Orders and Monk,
sentences.zh: 未来的客串明星，如果你能把三部《法律与秩序》和《神探阿蒙》全演一遍，

sentences.en: I'm going to drive to your house and give you a cake.
sentences.zh: 我要开车去你家送你一块蛋糕。

sentences.en: So, when I was trading emails with Rob, I was like, Rob, you've got to share what it was like in that room
sentences.zh: 所以，当我跟罗布发邮件时，我说，罗布，你得跟大家分享一下在那间会议室里的感受，

sentences.en: when Steve, as Michael, is falling apart.
sentences.zh: 当时史蒂夫饰演的迈克尔情绪崩溃。

sentences.en: How did you get through it?
And here's what he had to say.
My memories of shooting that scene in the conference room with Steve are mostly about just trying not to laugh
sentences.zh: 我拍摄那场在会议室和史蒂夫对戏的场景的记忆，大多都是关于努力克制自己别笑场，

sentences.en: because sometimes I just start laughing when people are funny because, really, I feel like a lot of times on comedy shows,
sentences.zh: 因为有时候别人搞笑时我就会忍不住笑起来，真的，我觉得很多时候在喜剧节目里，

sentences.en: you're trying to make the other person laugh.
In a way, you're kind of trying to f*** with them a little bit.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上，你其实有点想整整他们。

sentences.en: So, anyway, I was just trying to keep a straight face because Steve is so funny and Jenna is so funny
sentences.zh: 所以，总之，我只是在努力保持面不改色，因为史蒂夫太搞笑了，珍娜也太搞笑了，

sentences.en: and everybody on the show is so funny.
sentences.zh: 剧里的每个人都太搞笑了。

sentences.en: And I also get very nervous.
I get nervous going into a new show and, you know, there's this whole other culture there already established.
sentences.zh: 我进一个新的剧组会感到紧张，而且，你知道的，那里已经有一种完全成熟的文化了。

sentences.en: When you're a guest actor on a show, it's different because you don't know what you're walking into.
sentences.zh: 当你是剧中的客串演员时，情况有所不同，因为你不知道自己将要面对的是什么。

sentences.en: So, I was a little bit nervous and Steve is just, you know, iconic.
sentences.zh: 所以，我当时有点紧张，而且史蒂夫，你知道的，简直是标志性人物。
史蒂夫实在是太搞笑了。

sentences.en: And when he's kind of coming at me like that, he's, you know, putting me down and ignoring me and calling me names in a very funny way.
sentences.zh: 当他那样冲着我来的时候，你知道，他贬低我、忽视我，用一种非常搞笑的方式叫我绰号。

sentences.en: So, mostly trying not to laugh.
sentences.zh: 所以，主要就是在努力憋笑。

sentences.en: I loved his description of what it's like to be a guest actor on a show.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢他对作为一名客串演员身处剧组中的感受的描述。

sentences.en: Walking into the world and it's a comedy and it's supposed to be funny, but then you're not supposed to laugh.
sentences.zh: 走进这个世界，这是一部喜剧，本来就该搞笑，但你又偏偏不能笑。

sentences.en: I just, I related to all of that so much.
sentences.zh: 我真的是对这一切感同身受。

sentences.en: Well, we also asked him, does he still get recognized as AJ?
sentences.zh: 对了，我们还问了他，现在走在路上还会被认出是 AJ 吗？

sentences.en: He's been on, what did you say, 140?
sentences.zh: 他演过，你刚才说多少部？

sentences.en: Does he get recognized as AJ?
sentences.zh: 他会被认出是 AJ 吗？

sentences.en: Do I get recognized as AJ from The Office?
sentences.zh: 我会被认出是《办公室》里的 AJ 吗？

sentences.en: And I'm so thankful for it.
It is very fun to be recognized.
sentences.zh: 被人认出来是一件很有趣的事。

sentences.en: No matter what people tell you, it is fun because it's, you know, it's people love it.
sentences.zh: 不管别人怎么对你说，这真的很有趣，因为你知道，大家都很喜欢。

sentences.en: They love the show and that's fun.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢这部剧，这就很有趣。

sentences.en: You know, like everyone had an opinion about Michael and Holly's relationship and I was just standing in the way.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像每个人对迈克尔和霍莉的关系都有看法，而我恰好挡在中间。

sentences.en: So, I would get threatened by strangers.
sentences.zh: 所以，我经常受到陌生人的威胁。

sentences.en: In fact, people used to come up to me out of the blue.
sentences.zh: 事实上，人们以前经常无缘无故地走过来找我。

sentences.en: I remember people would sometimes whisper in my ear, like come up behind me and say, you stay away from Holly.
sentences.zh: 我记得有人有时会在我耳边低语，比如从我身后走过来对我说，离霍莉远点。

sentences.en: And what's crazy is that my wife in real life, her name is Holly.
sentences.zh: 而疯狂的是，我现实生活中的妻子，她的名字就叫霍莉。

sentences.en: So, I would have to decide in about two seconds, okay, is this someone that used to date my wife in real life that I should murder?
sentences.zh: 所以，我必须在大约两秒钟内做出决定，好吧，这究竟是我妻子现实生活中以前的约会对象，我该把他干掉？

sentences.en: Or is this just a fan of The Office acting like a creeper?
sentences.zh: 还是这只是一个行为诡异的《办公室》粉丝？

sentences.en: I love that his wife's name is Holly.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢他妻子叫霍莉这事了。

sentences.en: That is crazy though that people go up to him and they're like, leave Holly alone.
sentences.zh: 不过人们居然走过去对他说，离霍莉远点，这也太疯狂了。
而他的反应是，等等，什么？

sentences.en: Oh, I know what you are.
sentences.zh: 哦，我知道你是什么人了。

sentences.en: Well, thank you, Rob, for sending in your audio clips.
sentences.zh: 那么，罗布，谢谢你发来你的音频剪辑。

sentences.en: It was so nice of you.
I love listening to your voice.
I think he has a soothing, pleasant voice.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他的声音听起来很舒缓、很悦耳。
罗布，她可不是在开玩笑。

sentences.en: While we were recording this episode and you sent in your audio clips, Jenna was like, I just love the sound of his voice.
sentences.zh: 在我们录制这一集、你发来音频剪辑的时候，珍娜就说，我太喜欢他说话的声音了。

sentences.en: I hope you get tons of voiceover work because I would buy anything you're selling.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能接到大量配音工作，因为你卖什么我都会买。
那么，珍娜，迈克尔已经走了。

sentences.en: She goes right into Forrest Gump.
sentences.zh: 她直接用起了《阿甘正传》的梗。

sentences.en: Lady, this was one of my favorite shooting days ever, having to take over the presentation.
sentences.zh: 姑娘，这是我拍戏有史以来最喜欢的日子之一，得接管那个演示环节。

sentences.en: It was so fun to watch you.
I loved watching Pam try to do Michael's movie bits.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢看帕姆模仿迈克尔的电影桥段。

sentences.en: Angela, you know I'm not great with accents.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，你知道我不太擅长模仿口音。

sentences.en: I cannot tell you how hard I worked on that Forrest Gump voice.
sentences.zh: 我简直无法形容我为了练那个《阿甘正传》的嗓音费了多大劲。

sentences.en: Lady, I thought you were doing a bit to be bad, right?
sentences.zh: 大姐，我还以为你是在故意装演得不好，对吧？

sentences.en: And that is what Mindy and Ken Kwapis thought on set.
sentences.zh: 而这正是明迪和肯·クワピス在片场时的想法。

sentences.en: They were crying laughing when I did it.
sentences.zh: 我演的时候他们都笑哭了。

sentences.en: Mindy said it was genius that I was doing it so bad.
sentences.zh: 明迪说我演得这么烂简直是天才。

sentences.en: And I was texting with her because I was like, Mindy, do you remember this episode?
sentences.zh: 我还给她发短信，因为我就在想，明迪，你还记得这一集吗？

sentences.en: And she said, yes, I thought you were so funny that day.
sentences.zh: 她说，记得，我觉得那天你太搞笑了。

sentences.en: It was such a funny choice, you know, to be bad.
sentences.zh: 选择演得这么烂，真的是个超级搞笑的选择，你知道吧。

sentences.en: And I was like, Mindy, that was my literal best effort.
sentences.zh: 然后我说，明迪，那可是我字面意义上全力以赴的水平啊。

sentences.en: My acting limitations made me genius.
sentences.zh: 我演技的局限性让我成了天才。

sentences.en: Like, that's one of those things where, like, if I tried to be bad, it wouldn't have been as good as me giving it my best effort.
sentences.zh: 就像那种情况，如果我是故意想演砸，反而还不如我拼尽全力演得好呢。

sentences.en: I can't do it better than that.
sentences.zh: 我根本不可能比那演得更好了。
我去拿我的笔记本电脑。

sentences.en: I got, now, with that information in my brain, I've got to hear it because I thought, like Mindy, that you were doing a bit.
sentences.zh: 我现在知道了这个信息，我非听不可了，因为我和明迪一样，以为你是在搞笑整蛊。

sentences.en: At, like, I'm going to read it.
My first gump, kind of crappy.
But no, it was your best effort, honey.
sentences.zh: 但不是，亲爱的，那已经是你全力以赴了。

sentences.en: I listened to his voice in my head over and over and over and over again, and I tried to mimic it perfectly.
sentences.zh: 我脑子里一遍又一遍、一遍又一遍地听着他的声音，我试图完美地模仿它。

sentences.en: I have never loved you more, knowing now that that Forrest Gump was your earnest best effort.
sentences.zh: 现在知道那个阿甘是你认认真真拼尽全力演出来的，我简直不能更爱你了。

sentences.en: Sales is like a box of chocolates.
You never know which vendor you're going to get.
sentences.zh: 你永远不知道会遇到哪个供应商。
这简直是史上最可爱的事了。
大家伙儿，这难道不萌吗？

sentences.en: It was one of my most, you know, this was one of the few times when I was called upon to do, like, what would you call it?
sentences.zh: 那是我经历过为数不多的几次，怎么说呢，被要求去做的那种，你管这叫什么来着？

sentences.en: I was usually the receiver of comedy.
sentences.zh: 我通常是喜剧效果的承受者。

sentences.en: My job on this show was to amplify a comedic moment with my deadpan reaction.
sentences.zh: 我在这个节目里的工作，就是用我面无表情的反应来放大喜剧效果。

sentences.en: But in this case, I got to pitch the comedy ball, and it felt really good.
sentences.zh: 但这次，我得以抛出喜剧的橄榄枝，感觉真的很好。

sentences.en: Other people reacted off of you.
sentences.zh: 其他人根据你的反应来演。

sentences.en: Well, one of my favorite things to watch play out in any movie or TV show is when a character decides to step up to the plate and then bails.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我在任何电影或电视剧中最喜欢看的情节之一，就是一个角色决定迎难而上，然后却临阵脱逃了。

sentences.en: So, at the end, when Pam got out the chainsaw and was like, cutting down the competition.
sentences.zh: 所以，最后当帕姆拿出了电锯，就像是在砍掉竞争对手一样。
这种临阵脱逃是我最喜欢的。

sentences.en: Well, during all this, Michael has gone over to Holly's desk.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在这一切期间，迈克尔走到了霍莉的桌子旁。
他正抚摸着她的黄色开衫。

sentences.en: He cuts half of the sleeve off.
That made me laugh so hard, Jenna.
sentences.zh: 这让我笑得前仰后合，珍娜。

sentences.en: And then he, like, pushes the chair in, and this screensaver pops up of Martin Short, which is so perfect.
sentences.zh: 然后他，把椅子推进去，弹出了马丁·肖特的屏幕保护程序，这太完美了。

sentences.en: You know what Randy Cordray told me?
sentences.zh: 你知道兰迪·科德雷跟我说了什么吗？

sentences.en: Like, that was a whole thing.
He said we had this graphic artist on staff.
sentences.zh: 他说我们剧组有一个平面设计师。

sentences.en: And he had to build that on-screen computer graphic where there were these documents on the homepage, that picture of Martin Short.
sentences.zh: 他必须制作那个屏幕上的电脑图形，主页上有这些文档，还有那张马丁·肖特的照片。

sentences.en: They had to get permission to license that photo from Getty Images.
sentences.zh: 他们必须获得盖蒂图片社的授权许可才能使用那张照片。

sentences.en: I mean, that little moment, that was someone's day creating that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那个小细节，那是某人花了一整天创作出来的。

sentences.en: And I just, I love watching the show and thinking of those details.
sentences.zh: 而我就是喜欢看这部剧，然后想到这些细节。

sentences.en: Well, to finish out the Nashua Branch storyline, Pam and Michael, they pack up.
sentences.zh: 嗯，为了结束纳什亚分公司的故事线，帕姆和迈克尔收拾行李离开。

sentences.en: I love when Pam was like, don't look up.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢帕姆说“别抬头”的时候。

sentences.en: Don't look up when they're packing up the car.
sentences.zh: 当他们把行李装车时别抬头。

sentences.en: And they go to a diner.
sentences.zh: 然后他们去了一家餐馆。

sentences.en: And Michael confesses that, A, he cut off part of her sweater and that he saw a Dear Michael folder on her desktop.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔坦白说，第一，他剪了她毛衣的一部分，第二，他在她的桌面上看到一个“致迈克尔”的文件夹。

sentences.en: And Pam says, you can't read that.
And I won't tell you what the specifics are, but I can tell you if she still likes you.
sentences.zh: 而且我不会告诉你具体内容是什么，但我可以告诉你她是否还喜欢你。

sentences.en: We had a lot of fan mail about that.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了很多关于这部分的粉丝来信。

sentences.en: Emma S., Eric M., and Zachary C.
all wanted to know, was there a letter?
Or was I just pretending to read something?
sentences.zh: 还是我只是假装在读什么东西？

sentences.en: Phil Shea wrote a letter, and I was very grateful.
sentences.zh: 菲尔·谢伊写了一封信，我非常感激。

sentences.en: Because as I read it, it helped me get in a headspace.
sentences.zh: 因为当我读到它时，它帮我进入了一种状态。

sentences.en: Because there were all these things I read, but then I knew I was going to tell Michael the scripted lines of, like, it's not over.
sentences.zh: 因为我读了所有这些内容，但我知道我要对迈克尔说那些台词，比如，还没结束呢。

sentences.en: It was so helpful as an actor to have not just a blank screen there.
sentences.zh: 作为演员，眼前不只是一张空白的屏幕，这太有帮助了。

sentences.en: So thank you, Phil Shea, for writing me a letter.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你，菲尔·谢伊，给我写了一封信。

sentences.en: I wonder if Phil had to consult the writing staff and say, guys, I'm going to write this letter.
sentences.zh: 我想知道菲尔是不是得去问问编剧团队，说，伙计们，我要写这封信了。

sentences.en: Or he just did that on his own.
sentences.zh: 还是说他只是自己这么做的。

sentences.en: I think that was stuff he just did on his own.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那是他自己做的事。

sentences.en: He was a very detail-oriented prop master.
sentences.zh: 他是一个非常注重细节的道具师。

sentences.en: And he would often do that if we had a fakie piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 如果我们有一张假的纸条，他通常也会这么做。

sentences.en: I have a question for you.
Because when I watch this, I am always, like, relating it back to, like, things happening.
sentences.zh: 因为当我看到这里时，我总是会把它和正在发生的事情联系起来。

sentences.en: If you saw, like, something on your ex's computer, would you have read it?
sentences.zh: 如果你看到前任的电脑上有类似的东西，你会读吗？

sentences.en: I would have just sat down right then and there and read it.
sentences.zh: 我当时就会直接坐在那儿把它读完。

sentences.en: Well, listen, Michael is thrilled to find out that it's not over with Holly.
sentences.zh: 听着，迈克尔发现他和霍莉还没完，兴奋得不得了。

sentences.en: And we're not sure yet what he's going to do with that information, but he's happy to know it.
sentences.zh: 我们还不知道他要怎么利用这个消息，但他知道后很高兴。

sentences.en: He feels like he has closure.
We haven't talked about the rest of this birthday storyline.
sentences.zh: 我们还没聊过这个生日故事线的其他部分呢。

sentences.en: Well, listen, they're not doing very well.
sentences.zh: 听着，他们过得可不太好。

sentences.en: Jim and Dwight are still trying to brainstorm the perfect party for Kelly.
sentences.zh: 吉姆和德怀特还在绞尽脑汁为凯利策划完美的派对。

sentences.en: Jim says, okay, so far, our ideal party consists of beer, fights to the death, cupcakes, blood pudding, blood, touch football, mating, charades, and, yes, horse hunting.
sentences.zh: 吉姆说，好吧，到目前为止，我们理想的派对包括啤酒、生死决斗、纸杯蛋糕、血肠、鲜血、触式橄榄球、交配、猜字谜，还有，对，猎马。

sentences.en: But ultimately, they actually find a theme.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，他们确实找到一个主题。

sentences.en: Everyone gathers in the conference room.
You know what a chiclet is?
sentences.zh: 你知道什么是口香糖豆吗？

sentences.en: It's a piece of gum and it's a square.
sentences.zh: 它是一块口香糖，而且是方的。

sentences.en: It's a little square piece of gum.
sentences.zh: 是一小块方形的口香糖。

sentences.en: I like it that it has like a candy coating before I chew the gum.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢嚼口香糖前外面那层糖衣的感觉。
我喜欢那种脆脆的口感。

sentences.en: Kelly wants to know what's up with the chiclet.
sentences.zh: 凯莉想知道这口香糖是怎么回事。

sentences.en: Jim says, that's the best part.
sentences.zh: 吉姆说，这才是最棒的部分。

sentences.en: It's a pillow or a television.
sentences.zh: 是一个枕头或一台电视。

sentences.en: A pillow or a television is their theme.
sentences.zh: 枕头或电视就是他们的主题。

sentences.en: She gets to decide one hour of TV or an hour of napping.
sentences.zh: 她可以决定看一小时电视或睡一小时午觉。

sentences.en: I would, oh, I don't know if I could sleep at work.
sentences.zh: 我会，哦，我不知道我能不能在公司睡觉。

sentences.en: I have to be sick in order to take a nap.
sentences.zh: 我必须生病了才能睡个午觉。

sentences.en: Even if I've gotten three hours of sleep the night before, I can't nap.
sentences.zh: 即使我前一晚只睡了三个小时，我也无法午睡。
我会变成那种极度疲惫却又很亢奋的状态。

sentences.en: So, I mean, I'm in the middle of the White Lotus.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，我正在看《白莲花度假村》。

sentences.en: I'm in the middle of Hacks.
I only just finished Mare of Easttown.
Do you hear how behind I am?
sentences.zh: 你听得出我落后多少进度了吧？

sentences.en: So, hour of TV, yes, please.
sentences.zh: 所以，看一小时电视，好啊，求之不得。
这对我来说听起来太奢侈了。

sentences.en: Also, yeah, I can't sleep during the day.
sentences.zh: 而且，对啊，我白天睡不着觉。

sentences.en: Something has to be wrong with me if I fall asleep during the day.
sentences.zh: 如果我大白天睡着了，那一定是我身体出问题了。

sentences.en: It's just like my body just won't do it.
sentences.zh: 就好像我的身体根本不允许我这么做。

sentences.en: I do think this is a little bit of an old tech alert.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这有点像是老旧科技警报。

sentences.en: They say that the chiclet represents a pillow or a television.
sentences.zh: 他们说口香糖代表枕头或电视。

sentences.en: And I think at work now, we would just watch an hour on our phone or our computer.
sentences.zh: 我觉得现在在公司，我们大概只会用手机或电脑看一小时。

sentences.en: And also, doesn't Stanley say there's nothing good on right now?
sentences.zh: 而且，斯坦利不是说过现在没什么好看的节目吗？

sentences.en: Well, Creed says Bonnie Hunt's on.
sentences.zh: 哦，克里德说邦妮·亨特正在播。

sentences.en: But it's that they're going to watch like live television.
sentences.zh: 但它们会像看直播电视一样去观看。

sentences.en: So, I would say their theme was a little bit of an old tech alert.
sentences.zh: 所以，我觉得他们的主题有点像老科技警报。

sentences.en: And she takes a little nap under the conference table.
sentences.zh: 她在会议桌下小睡了一会儿。

sentences.en: And while she does, Jim and Dwight sit on that little couch by reception.
sentences.zh: 在她这么做的时候，吉姆和德怀特坐在接待处旁边的那张小沙发上。

sentences.en: And they're very proud of themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们对自己感到非常骄傲。

sentences.en: And I want to point out this scene to everyone.
sentences.zh: 我想向大家指出这个场景。

sentences.en: Because John is doing a classic fakey, eaty acting technique with this cake.
sentences.zh: 因为约翰在这个蛋糕场景中使用了经典的假吃表演技巧。

sentences.en: He's shoving the food around the plate.
sentences.zh: 他在盘子里推挤着食物。

sentences.en: He would take a big scoop of cake.
sentences.zh: 他会舀起很大一勺蛋糕。

sentences.en: But then, he smushes it back down.
sentences.zh: 但随后，他又把它压回盘子里。

sentences.en: And so, by the time he puts it in his mouth, it just has a little frosting on it.
sentences.zh: 所以，等他把它放进嘴里时，上面其实只有一点糖霜。

sentences.en: He goes for the cake three times and never actually eats a piece.
sentences.zh: 他去拿了三次蛋糕，却从来没有真正吃上一块。

sentences.en: At the beginning, he eats like half a piece.
sentences.zh: 一开始，他吃了一半左右。

sentences.en: You have to do this because otherwise you're going to get sick.
sentences.zh: 你必须这样做，否则你会生病的。

sentences.en: However, sitting next to him is Rainn Wilson, who eats the cake.
sentences.zh: 然而，坐在他旁边的是雷恩·威尔逊，他可是真吃蛋糕。

sentences.en: Because Rainn always ate in scenes.
sentences.zh: 因为雷恩在拍戏时总是吃东西。

sentences.en: Remember, he ate so many bananas, he got sick.
sentences.zh: 记得吗，他吃了那么多香蕉，结果吃病了。

sentences.en: When Rainn, as Dwight, does anything, he goes all out.
sentences.zh: 当雷恩饰演德怀特时，他做什么都是全力以赴。

sentences.en: And I feel like Rainn eats in scenes the way Brad Pitt eats in movies.
sentences.zh: 我觉得雷恩在剧中的吃相，就像布拉德·皮特在电影里的吃相一样。

sentences.en: I wanted to know, like, is this a choice?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，这算是一种选择吗？

sentences.en: Do you see how much steak and pasta those guys eat?
sentences.zh: 你看到那些家伙吃了多少牛排和意面吗？

sentences.en: When I watch it, I get hungry.

sentences.zh: 那是《讲座巡回演出》第二部分。

sentences.en: With a little bit of movie.
We had, I felt like, a lot of interesting movie magic facts.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们有很多有趣的电影魔术冷知识。

sentences.en: A lot of cat grooming facts.
sentences.zh: 许多关于猫咪美容的冷知识。
还有一个阿甘正传的模仿秀。

sentences.en: And next week is Blood Drive.
I've got some good facts about the Blood Mobile.
sentences.zh: 我有一些关于献血车的有趣事实。

sentences.en: It was actually on the set.
It was in the parking lot.
I'll tell you all about it next week.
sentences.zh: 下周我会在节目里详细讲讲。
